text: Right I've tried ringing three times now and keep getting cut off so I'm typing this out instead. I'm looking after my sister's baby tonight while she's on a night shift, he's 2 months old, a boy. He felt warm when I picked him up so I got the thermometer out of her drawer and it said 38.2. Did it again under his arm about five minutes later and it said 38.2 again so I don't think it's the thermometer playing up. His breathing is fine, I've been watching him and it's just normal, nice and steady, nothing weird. I can't get hold of my sister because she can't have her phone on the ward and honestly I just want someone to tell me what I'm supposed to do with a baby this little with a temperature because the leaflet she's got is for older kids. Please can someone actually get back to me this time.
